question.problem: Johnny walked $\frac{3}{8}$ of a mile in  $7$ minutes, keeping an even pace. How many miles did he walk in $1$ minute?
question.worked_solution:
To compute the number of miles Johnny  walked in $1$ minute, we can compute the unit rate of miles per minute. We do this by dividing the number of miles, $\frac{3}{8},$ by the number of minute, as follows:   

$$
\frac{3}{8}÷7
$$

Dividing a fraction by a whole number is equivalent to multiplying the fraction by the reciprocal of that whole number:

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{3}{8}÷7 & =\frac{3}{8}\times \frac{1}{7} \\  & =\frac{3\times 1}{8\times 7} \\  & =\frac{3}{56}\end{aligned}
$$

So, Johnny walked  $\frac{3}{56}$ miles in $1$ minute.
